node_notes.app: The application initializes the shared I2C bus and runs a startup address scan. Its calls to i2c_bus_init and i2c_bus_scan are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.logger: This portable formatter builds newline-terminated diagnostic records and forwards them to the platform logging contract. Formatting and the call to logger_platform_write are implemented in firmware/utils/logger/logger.c.
node_notes.log_bridge: This platform bridge initializes USART2 as needed and forwards log bytes to its write function. The forwarding implementation is logger_platform_write in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_logger.c.
node_notes.i2c_periph: This is the I2C1 hardware used for the scan, configured with PB8 as SCL and PB9 as SDA. The pin configuration is established by APP_I2C1_GPIO_PORT and the SCL/SDA macros in firmware/configs/app_config.h and HAL_I2C_MspInit in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c.
node_notes.console: The UART output is identified as the NUCLEO-G070RB ST-LINK Virtual COM Port in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c and firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.h.
node_notes.i2c_contract: This vendor-neutral contract exposes initialization and serialized bus scanning to the application. The relevant APIs are i2c_bus_init and i2c_bus_scan in firmware/interfaces/i2c_bus.h.
node_notes.uart_periph: USART2 carries the logging output at the configured 115200 baud. firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_uart2.c configures TX on PA2 and RX on PA3 and transmits with HAL_UART_Transmit.
node_notes.i2c_adapter: The STM32 adapter implements the bus contract and performs address probes through HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady. Its initialization and scan implementations are in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c.

node_notes.init: The application initializes the shared bus before scanning it. This step calls i2c_bus_init from firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.scan_ok: The application checks the scan result before reporting results. A failed scan takes the error-and-return path in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.init_ok: The application checks the initialization status and returns after logging an error if initialization failed. The branch is the status test in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.scan: The application scans the bus and gathers acknowledging addresses. firmware/app/app.c calls i2c_bus_scan, whose STM32 implementation probes addresses using HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady in firmware/platforms/stm32/platform_i2c1.c.
node_notes.ready: On successful initialization, the application logs that I2C1 is ready on PB8/SCL and PB9/SDA. The readiness message is in firmware/app/app.c and the pin assignments are in firmware/configs/app_config.h.
node_notes.enter: Core/Src/main.c calls app_start after the HAL and clock setup. This enters the application startup path rather than treating the generated main loop as application behavior.
node_notes.more_acks: The application iterates through the returned acknowledged-address count and logs each address. The loop condition is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.scan_error: This step logs the scan failure status and returns from the startup reporting function. The branch body is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.ack_log: Each iteration logs one acknowledged 7-bit address through the logger. The LOGI call is in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.init_error: A failed bus initialization emits an error record and ends app_start. The log call and return are in firmware/app/app.c.
node_notes.summary: For a successful scan, the application logs the ACK total and the NACK probe count. The log call and count retrieval are in firmware/app/app.c.

sequence.title: Sequence Diagram
sequence.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Boot as Core main
  participant App as app_start
  participant I2C as I2C1 bus adapter
  participant Log as Log formatter and UART bridge
  participant Console as ST-LINK VCP console

  Boot->>App: app_start
  App->>I2C: i2c_bus_init
  alt I2C initialization fails
    I2C-->>App: IO error status
    App->>Log: LOGE initialization failure
    Log->>Console: Transmit diagnostic on USART2 PA2
  else I2C initialization succeeds
    I2C-->>App: OK status
    App->>Log: LOGI bus ready on PB8 and PB9
    Log->>Console: Transmit readiness message on USART2 PA2
    App->>I2C: i2c_bus_scan
    loop Probe addresses 0x08 through 0x77
      I2C->>I2C: HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady
      alt Target acknowledges
        I2C-->>App: Record acknowledged address
      else Target does not acknowledge
        I2C-->>App: Increment NACK probe count
      end
    end
    alt Scan fails
      I2C-->>App: Scan error status
      App->>Log: LOGE scan failure
      Log->>Console: Transmit scan error on USART2 PA2
    else Scan succeeds
      I2C-->>App: ACK addresses and NACK count
      App->>Log: LOGI scan totals
      Log->>Console: Transmit scan totals on USART2 PA2
      loop For each acknowledged address
        App->>Log: LOGI acknowledged address
        Log->>Console: Transmit address on USART2 PA2
      end
    end
  end
